```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(ggtree)
library(khroma)
library(cartography)
library(ggnewscale)

# Load Branch statistics
recomb_predictions_CDC <- read.gff("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Gubbins/CDC/Fulltree/recombination_predictions.gff", na.strings = c(".", "?"), GFF3 = TRUE)
recomb_predictions_NDL <- read.gff("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Gubbins/NDL/recombination_predictions.gff", na.strings = c(".", "?"), GFF3 = TRUE)
  
# Get accessory regions from Missingness proportion 
Missingness_Prop_CDC <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/CDC/Missingness_Prop.txt")
CDC_Accesory_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop_CDC |> filter(V2>=0.05) |> pull(V1)
CDC_Core_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop_CDC |> filter(V2<0.05) |> pull(V1)

Missingness_Prop_NDL <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/1.Bioinformatics/Ouputs/Pyseer Results/NDL/Missingness_Prop.txt")
NDL_Accesory_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop_NDL |> filter(V2>=0.05) |> pull(V1)
NDL_Core_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop_NDL |> filter(V2<0.05) |> pull(V1)

# Get cps locus
cps_POS <- 1193391:1209001

# merge consecutive positions into ranges
get_ranges <- function(pos) {
  if (length(pos) == 0) return(data.frame(start=integer(), end=integer()))
  pos <- sort(pos)
  split <- c(0, cumsum(diff(pos) != 1))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pos, split), function(x) data.frame(start=min(x), end=max(x))))
}

# Preparing shading data
cps_df <- get_ranges(cps_POS)
cps_df$region_type <- "cps locus"

CDC_accessory_df <- get_ranges(CDC_Accesory_region_POS)
CDC_accessory_df$region_type <- "Accessory region"
CDC_shaded_regions <- bind_rows(CDC_accessory_df, cps_df) %>%
  mutate(alpha = ifelse(region_type == "Accessory region", 0.2, 1))

NDL_accessory_df <- get_ranges(NDL_Accesory_region_POS)
NDL_accessory_df$region_type <- "Accessory region"
NDL_shaded_regions <- bind_rows(NDL_accessory_df, cps_df) %>%
  mutate(alpha = ifelse(region_type == "Accessory region", 0.2, 1))

# Define positions for sig hits
green_pos <- data.frame(what = c("T1206469C", "T1216249C", "C1249780T", "C1250385A", "A1250938G", "Unitig_1", "Unitig_2", "Unitig_3", "Unitig_7", "Unitig_8", "Unitig_9", "Unitig_10", "Unitig_11", "Unitig_12"), 
                        start= c(1206469-20, 1216249-20, 1249780-20, 1250385-20, 1250938-20, 1206439, 1216431, 1238722, 1198989, 1198992, 1201107, 1201748, 1201754, 1203290), 
           end= c(1206469+20, 1216249+20, 1249780+20, 1250385+20, 1250938+20, 1206470, 1216469, 1238768, 1199021, 1199027, 1201138, 1201783, 1201796, 1203334), 
           region_type= "Sig. hits", 
           alpha=1)
CDC_shaded_regions2 <- rbind(CDC_shaded_regions, green_pos |> select(-what)) |>
  mutate(alpha= ifelse(region_type == "cps locus", 0.4, alpha))
NDL_shaded_regions2 <- rbind(NDL_shaded_regions, green_pos |> select(-what)) |>
  mutate(alpha= ifelse(region_type == "cps locus", 0.4, alpha))

# prep sig hit labels
green_pos <- green_pos  %>%
  arrange(start)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(x_mid = (start + end) / 2)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_lab = c(0, 600, 1800, 2200, 2600, 3400, 600, 1800, 600, 1800, 2200, 600, 1800, 2600))
```


# Plot distribution of Recombination block and regions, highlighting accessory regions and the cps locus
## CDC
```{r}
# Plot Recombination blocks
p_recomb_block_CDC <- recomb_predictions_CDC %>%
  mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = mid), bins = 1000, 
                 fill = "grey80", color = "black") +
  geom_rect(
    data = CDC_shaded_regions,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = region_type, alpha = alpha),
    color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Region", 
    values = c("Accessory region" = "red", "cps locus" = "blue")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +  # use the alpha values directly
  theme_classic()
p_recomb_block_CDC

# Plot The number of Recombination blocks spanning each genomic position
deconvoluted_df_CDC <- recomb_predictions_CDC %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(position = list(seq(start, end))) %>%   # List of positions for each row
  unnest(position) %>%
  ungroup()


# ADD significant hits
p_recomb_sig_pos_CDC <- deconvoluted_df_CDC %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = position), bins = 100000, 
                 fill = "grey50", color = "grey50") +
  geom_rect(
    data = CDC_shaded_regions2,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = region_type, alpha = alpha),
    color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Region", 
    values = c("Accessory region" = "red", "cps locus" = "blue", "Sig. hits" = "green3")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +  # use the alpha values directly
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Genomic Position")+
  ylab("Number of Spanning Recombination Blocks")
p_recomb_sig_pos_CDC


# ADD labels
p_recomb_sig_pos_label_CDC <- deconvoluted_df_CDC %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = position), bins = 500,
                 fill = "grey50", color = "grey50") +
  geom_rect(
    data = CDC_shaded_regions2,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = region_type, alpha = alpha),
    color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # labels for green_pos
  geom_text(
    data = green_pos,
    aes(x = end, y =y_lab, label = what),   # adjust y as needed
    angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0,
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color= "green3"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Region",
    values = c("Accessory region" = "red",
               "cps locus" = "blue",
               "Sig. hits" = "green3")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Genomic Position") +
  ylab("Number of Spanning Recombination Blocks")

p_zoom_CDC <- p_recomb_sig_pos_label_CDC+ 
  xlim(1193390, 1252000) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
  

p_full_CDC <- p_recomb_sig_pos_CDC +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none")

# Arrange one above the other (patchwork)
library(patchwork)
empty <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
p_zoom_null_CDC <- (p_zoom_CDC / empty) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

p_save_CDC <- p_full_CDC + p_zoom_null_CDC 
# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_recombination_tract.png", plot = p_save_CDC, width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/2. Analysis/MS1 - USA GWAS interpretation/CDC_recombination_tract.tiff", plot = p_save_CDC, width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

# Get rates of recombination across genome, comparing accessory, core and cps locus
## CDC
```{r}
# Rate in accessory regions
Accesory_deconvoluted_df_CDC <- deconvoluted_df_CDC |>  filter(position %in% CDC_Accesory_region_POS) 
r_acc_CDC <- nrow(Accesory_deconvoluted_df_CDC)/length(CDC_Accesory_region_POS)
r_acc_CDC
# on average, around 34.0 recombination blocks span each genomic position in accessory regions. 

# Rate in Core regions
Core_deconvoluted_df_CDC <- deconvoluted_df_CDC |>  filter(position %in% CDC_Core_region_POS) 
r_core_CDC <- nrow(Core_deconvoluted_df_CDC)/length(CDC_Core_region_POS)
r_core_CDC
# on average, around 8.4 recombination blocks span each genomic position in core regions. 

# Rate in cps locus
cps_deconvoluted_df_CDC <- deconvoluted_df_CDC |>  filter(position %in% cps_POS) 
r_cps_CDC <- nrow(cps_deconvoluted_df_CDC)/length(cps_POS)
r_cps_CDC
# on average, around 36.1 recombination blocks span each genomic position in the cps locus 

# Rate around the cps locus
cps_around_deconvoluted_df_CDC <- deconvoluted_df_CDC |>  filter(position %in% 1193391:1250000) 
r_cps_around_CDC <- nrow(cps_around_deconvoluted_df_CDC)/length(1193391:1250000)
r_cps_around_CDC
# on average, around 36.5 recombination blocks span each genomic position around the cps locus 
```
